findings.highlight: it was pierced through with a sword
findings.governingReading: 貫通しかけた says the sword came close to passing through; severe damage and attached arm remain.
findings.explanation: Nearly penetrating through becomes a completed through-wound.

findings.governingReading: After Rin looks angrily at Shirou, the narration places the silently rejecting figure behind her.
findings.explanation: The English places the silent figure behind Shirou instead of behind Rin, changing the rooftop arrangement.

findings.highlight: This pain is proof that I've been saved by Saber until now.
findings.evidenceJa: 今までセイバーによって助けられていたっていうのなら尚更だ
findings.governingReading: If this pain means Saber was saving him until now, he is all the more involved: 尚更 refers to his rebuttal that he does have a stake in her fate.
findings.explanation: Past protection replaces the strengthened reason to remain responsible.
